clips.notes: standing relaxed, slow breathing, weight settles from one foot to the other (hips lead), hands loosely together in front, looks round the room with a soft smile (neck leads, head follows), irregular blinks; mantle drape and belt end settle

warm, open-handed: the right hand opens palm-up toward the listener on the first phrase, both hands open on the second, the left hand to the heart at the end; nods on stressed syllables; jaw in an irregular syllable rhythm (lip sync overrides it)
calm, unhurried walk (100 steps/min): small hip bob, chest counter-turn, relaxed arm swing with lagging forearms, head level; mantle and belt end swing late

standing teaching: turns from the left side of the room to the right and back (feet stay, hips -> chest -> head), the right hand open and explaining, the left hand comes to his heart twice; jaw in a talking rhythm; a smile nod to each side
dust falls: a little start, he looks up at the ceiling (neck first, head after, chin high), a short laugh (shoulders bob twice), then a warm smile held looking up; hands open a little at his sides

in place (no walk): he kneels down on his left knee, right foot forward, leans toward the man lying 0.12 in front (KNEEL_D), the right hand reaching toward him, palm down, hovering over his chest; the left hand rests on the raised knee; gentle head tilt; holds, breathing. Knee on the floor (meshMinY >= -0.008)
from kneel_kind's end pose he rises (push on the raised knee), turns his chest and head to the room and raises the right hand, open, as he speaks; holds standing, the hand up
'Get up!': a breath, turns square to the man, both palms sweep up from low in front to chest height, open and lifting (palms up), with a small rise onto the toes and a firm nod; holds, palms up

asleep on his left side facing the viewer, head toward his +X resting on the stern cushion (head 0.045 up), knees drawn up, the lower hand under his cheek; slow deep breathing (two breaths per 5 s loop), a little smile, one foot twitch; eyes shut. Root under his shoulder; hips 0.115 toward -X, feet ~0.22

from lie_sleep: opens his eyes calmly, pushes up on the lower arm and comes up onto his knees (sitting back on his heels), looks at Peter (toward his -X), then rises to standing at the root, no hurry, no fright; ends standing, calm, hands low

stands firm (feet apart), lifts both arms out over the water, palms down, held strong at `calm` (1.0 s), then lowers them slowly, palms still down, as if smoothing the sea; ends standing, arms low, calm
a warm laugh: head tips back a little, shoulders shake in four shrinking bursts, the left hand to his chest; ends in the plain standing pose
friendly wave with the right hand beside his head, a little side sway, head tilted, the left hand low
a big man at ease: weight shifts from foot to foot (hips lead, chest late), fists on his hips for the middle of the loop, then arms hang; looks round, a hum (small jaw); blinks
big open gestures: both arms swing wide palms-up on the stressed words (left phrase, right phrase, both), chest out, a belly chuckle (shoulders bounce), nods; jaw in a syllable rhythm
rolling fisherman's walk: feet apart, the body rolls over each planted foot (hips and chest roll, head level), arms out from the body swinging wide, a bounce per step
dust hits him: a big flinch (ducks, shoulders up, eyes squeezed), then he looks straight up, both hands slap onto the top of his head (elbows wide, face clear), mouth wide open; holds

brushes the dust out of his hair (both hands scrubbing the top of his head), then out of his beard (one hand under the chin), then shakes his head like a wet dog (fast head shakes with the shoulders following); squints; ends standing, blinking, hands low
a big belly laugh: head back, shoulders and belly bouncing, the right hand slaps his thigh twice per loop (knee comes up a little to meet it), the left hand on his belly; mouth wide
calm: the right hand on the steering-oar handle at his right side (imagined handle; ANIMATION.md), the left fist on his hip, legs apart; sways with the boat, looks out over the water and back, hums

in the storm: both hands on the oar handle at his right, heaving it hard left and right (the whole body throws its weight into it, chest turning, hips pushing), legs braced wide and bent, head ducked into the wind, teeth gritted, squinting

frantic bailing with the bucket in his right hand: bends deep (knees and hips), scoops low in front-right (`scoop`), heaves it up across his body and flings the water out over the side to his LEFT (`throw`, left hand under the bucket), straight back down; eyes wide, mouth open

bends right over the sleeper lying in front of him (lie_sleep root WAKE_D = 0.10 in front, facing him, head to Peter's right): knees bent, both hands on the sleeper's upper shoulder, shaking him in two panicky bursts per loop, wailing (jaw wide on the bursts), eyes wide, head-cloth tail flicking
slowly straightens up (from a crouch), mouth falls open, hands half raised and open, looks slowly round at the flat water (left ... right), a little shake of the head in disbelief; holds
crouched low, hugging his knees (head ducked between his shoulders), rocking a little; a thunder flinch per loop (`thunder`: shoulders jump, eyes squeezed shut); scared face
a big two-arm wave over his head, rocking side to side, beaming
on his back on the flat mat (mat bone at rest), head toward -X and a little raised, hands folded on his chest; slow breathing, irregular blinks, the toes wiggle once, he glances to his right and back

lying on the mat as in lie_mat, but body and mat lifted as one and turned so the poles run along his facing (head toward -Z, feet first); one small dip per carrier step (0.8 s), he clutches the mat nervously and turns his head to look round (left, ahead, right). Carriers: friend1 carry_front CARRY_D ahead, friend2 carry_back CARRY_D behind, started on the same frame
clips.rootMotionNote: static lift: root raised CARRY_HAND - CARRY_Y - POLE_C (pole centres at world 0.15 on base CARRY_Y 0.10) plus a 0.004 bob per step; mat turned 90 deg so its poles run along the travel

clips.notes: 5 s. Lying on the mat (lie_mat pose) as he is let down through the roof: four ropes from the mat corners rise to the friends' hands (their tops held at local y ROPE_TOP = 0.47; the ropes shorten as he goes down), the mat swings +-4 deg and jolts at each catch; he clutches the mat edges, looks up at the friends, then down at the floor; lands with a little bump at 4.6 s, ropes slack and shrink away by `land` (4.8 s); ends in lie_mat's pose, blinking
clips.rootMotionNote: root starts at local y +0.40 (the roof) and comes down in four eased stages to 0 at frame 138 (4.6 s), a 3 mm bump on landing; play at base y 0 on LAND

clips.notes: from lie_mat: a breath, he pushes up slowly on his hands and sits up facing his feet (+X), stares at his legs in wonder, wiggles his toes (twice), then turns his head toward his +Z (Jesus) with a hopeful look; holds sitting

like a newborn calf, standing on his mat (feet 0.026 up on the pad): from sit_up's pose he turns to face +Z, draws his knees in, pushes up bottom-first, rises onto knock-kneed wobbly legs, arms flung out for balance, lurching left and right; two tiny unsure steps in place (each with a wobble), then he straightens up tall, arms down, and blinks at his own legs; holds standing

on his mat: leaps up twice (crouch, high hop with knees tucked, land), arms flung high, then lands laughing, shoulders bouncing; ends in the plain standing pose on the mat. The root does not move (the mat stays down)

steps back off the mat, squats and rolls it up with both hands (rolling forward away from him); at 1.2 s (`switch`, the timeline swaps the props mat -> matRoll) he grabs the roll and heaves it up onto his left shoulder (`shoulder`), then steps forward back onto his mark, proud; holds, holding the roll (= idle)

skipping, spinning dance with the rolled mat on his left shoulder: two step-hops (knees high, the free right arm swinging up, head bobbing, laughing), then a hop-and-spin (a full turn in the air, `spin`); travels: naturalSpeed in clips.json (the director moves him at that speed)
happy bouncy walk with the rolled mat on his left shoulder (left hand on it), the right arm swinging freely, a spring in every step, head up, smiling
standing talk, both hands free: shy, eager gestures (hands open at chest height, a hand to his chest on 'me'), small nods, weight shifting; jaw in a syllable rhythm
standing happily, the rolled mat on his left shoulder (left hand on it), the right hand loose; bounces lightly on his toes now and then, looks round smiling, blinks
waving with the free right hand high, the rolled mat on his left shoulder, bouncing on his toes, beaming
